title: Book One · Chapter 103: The Last Three Stones
story:
The borrowed basin is blue and very deep.

Miss Wu puts only enough water in it for the tests. She marks the height with tape outside the basin. Ronan checks the table. It is steady. Then he carries their boat over.

“Empty,” Mei says.

He lowers the flat boat onto the water. The old pale line is just above the new water line. Every piece is still firm after winter and the waiting days.

Leo's group watches from the next table. They finished their test. Their string boat carried two stones. Then they added a third stone. That stone moved towards one side. The boat tipped.

Ronan wants his own boat to carry three again. He told Mum about that result. There is a space for this last result. Ronan wants a mark to put there.

Mei holds up one finger. He puts the first stone in the middle. She makes the mark. The second goes beside it. The boat lowers slightly.

With the third, he stops above the water.

“Where exactly?” he asks.

Mei looks at their drawing. “Close to the other two. Not on top.”

He lowers it carefully. The boat shifts, then becomes still. All three stones stay above the water.

Ronan grins widely. Leo laughs at his grin.

“We can see all your teeth,” Leo says. “Are you that happy about your boat?”

The boys get quiet. Then Mei writes the result. This time every mark has a name and number.

“Shall we try stones at the front again?” Miss Wu asks. Ronan wants to finish with the good result.

“We know it tips,” he says.

“Where is today's front test on your final page?”

He looks at the blank second box. It does not say anything yet.

They take all three stones out. The boat rises. Ronan puts one near the front, then the second. The front goes under. Both stones slide off, just as before.

He feels sad to see it tip. Mei writes beside the picture with stones at the front. The page shows both results. Three stones in the middle stayed on the boat. Two at the front tipped it.

At the next table, Leo asks to borrow the flat boat for a look. Ronan says yes after they dry it. Leo checks the cross strips. “Who had the idea for these?” he asks.

“Mei drew them first,” Ronan says. “I helped fit them.”

Mei looks up. “And we measured the wood. Then we changed the pieces.”

Leo turns it gently. His partners call him back to help put their own model away. He returns the flat boat. He does not ask for another test against his own.

The class cleans up for the last ten minutes. Ronan tips no water himself. The adults empty the large basin. Ronan and Mei dry the table. They count the stones and put them in the cup.

There are three. They used these same three stones in every test. Now all three are back in the cup.

Ronan wants to keep one. He asks Miss Wu.

“They belong to the class set,” she says. “You may draw one.”

He draws a stone on his new birthday paper. It is a small grey shape, hard to make interesting. Under it he writes THREE IN THE MIDDLE. The drawing is simple. But he remembers all the tests with the stones. He can tell Mum about them when he gets home.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- lowers＝放低、轻放下
- at the front＝在前端
- slide off＝滑落
- same three stones＝同样的三颗石头

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：tape＝胶带；steady＝稳的；set＝一套。

## 读句提示

**Who had the idea for these?**

谁／想出了／这些横条的办法？had在这里是“有过”，不是had＋过去分词。

## 理解问题

1. 最终页面为什么既要写成功，也要写限度？
2. Ronan怎样说明Mei的真实贡献？
